title: An equiconsistency proof for $\mathrm{CZF} + V = L$
summary: In many axiomatic set theories, Gödel's constructible universe $L$ is known as an inner model, that is, a definable class satisfying the same axioms (and containing the same ordinals). This gives a trivial proof that adding the axiom $V = L$ does not increase the consistency strength of the theory. In this paper, we shall look at a system of intuitionistic set theory known as $\mathrm{CZF}$, where $L$ fails to exhibit such nice properties.
